meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先自己在真实界面上跑手工 QA 并留下证据，再只派一个审查者（不组队）对照目标、约束、代码质量、安全与 QA 证据审计整份改动；QA 出现失败行就直接判 REVIEW FAILED。
howto.when: 在 PR 交付前，或用户明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查刚完成的改动，先自己做手工 QA
say.note: 会先收集目标与 diff，再开一个审查者

say.text: 交接 PR 前跑一遍 gate review
say.note: QA 有失败行会直接判 REVIEW FAILED

say.text: 审查者只派一个，别组面板
say.note: 原文规定只用单个 gate reviewer

howto.what_en: Claude runs hands-on manual QA on the real surface and captures artifacts, then launches exactly ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit the change against goal, constraints, quality, security and QA evidence. Any failing QA row ends the review.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Review the work I just finished; run manual QA yourself first.
say_en.note: Gathers goal and diff, then spawns one reviewer.

say_en.text: Run a gate review before the PR handoff.
say_en.note: A failing QA row means REVIEW FAILED.

say_en.text: Use just one gate reviewer, not a panel.
say_en.note: The skill specifies a single gate reviewer.
